GATE_FINDING.rule: addendum Item 4: freeze t where measured classical row >= 10x predicted quantum wall (best-classical-tool, all-core = give classical its best shot = honest advantage floor)
GATE_FINDING.note: quantum wall is Whisper's Item-2 noise-band deliverable (1M shots on Heron ~ minutes); ratios below are parametric in that number.
GATE_FINDING.GATE: t=64 is INSUFFICIENT (7.3x < 10x at quantum~3min). The fresh pre-reg must freeze at t>=72 (37x) for a clean >=10x advantage against the BEST classical tool. t=80 gives 182x margin.

direction_of_error: Raw extstab wall-time (sampler-config inflated) would OVERSTATE the classical bill => inflate the apparent advantage. Anchor(paper-shape) x measured-edge is the anti-flattering choice, not merely strawman-avoidance. Gating on best_c_allcore (classical's best tool) is the conservative advantage floor.
